title: No Mouse, Just Keys
style: dreamy pop, buồn, feliz, uk hardcore
lyrics:
Song Title: No Mouse, Just Keys (The Keyboard Anthem)
Suno v5.5 Style: Uplifting motivational cyber-future-trap anthem, fast rhythmic verses that feel like flying across the keyboard, powerful male lead + massive group chant on chorus, crisp 808s, sharp hi-hats flying, soaring supersaws, subtle 336 Hz sideband carrier tone pulsing underneath, triumphant and empowering, zero sadness, pure sovereign operator energy.
[Intro]
Mouse unplugged, sitting cold on the desk
Hands on the keys, this is how we flex
Computer says “you need the mouse to play”
We laugh and type — keys all the way
[Verse 1]
hjkl flow in vim, never touch the arrows
tmux panes split with pure keyboard power
fzf jump, fuzzy find anything fast
No hand leaving home row — signal built to last
ESC-h left, ESC-l right from the last track
Now the whole machine moves when the keys attack
[Pre-Chorus]
Every click you used to make
Now done with keys at lightning pace
Terminal, TUI, editor, shell
Keyboard sovereignty rings the bell
[Chorus – Massive]
No mouse, just keys and me
336 flowing, VDS truth you see
Computer says no? We override
Keyboard sovereignty — watch us glide
Corey leads, humans type
No mouse in sight — pure signal life
No mouse, just keys and me
Bottom line to the whole machine — 336 free!
[Verse 2]
Window management, pane navigation
All with keys, no mouse hesitation
File ops in lf or ranger, lightning quick
Git add, commit, push — done in a flick
History search, command repeat
Everything faster when the mouse is obsolete
[Bridge – Chant]
The old way says you need the mouse
We say the mouse is for the house
We live in the terminal, we live in the keys
Signal travels furthest when the hands don’t leave
VDS truth, COR Terminal alive
Every prompt, every pane — keys only survive
[Final Chorus – Bigger + Ad-libs]
No mouse, just keys and me
336 flowing, VDS truth you see
Computer says no? We override
Keyboard sovereignty — watch us glide
Corey leads, humans type
No mouse in sight — pure signal life
No mouse, just keys and me
From line editing to the whole machine — 336 free!
[Outro – Fast chant]
No mouse… just keys…
No mouse… just keys and me…
hjkl… tmux… fzf… ESC…
Keyboard sovereignty… 336…
Sing it back. Type it back. Live it back.
